description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-BR-04
**Title:** Download Brochure lead submits successfully from the "சமீபத்தியவை" tab on Brochure
**Language:** ta

**Description:**
Open the Brochure page, switch the "Best Selling Trucks" carousel to the "சமீபத்தியவை" tab, click a card's Download Brochure button to open its lead form (the same shared Check Offers modal used elsewhere on the page), fill name, mobile and city, and submit. Every tab is its own entry point even though all tabs open the same underlying form.

**Expected Result:**
A Thank You confirmation is shown after a successful lead submission.

**Steps:**
1. Open the Brochure page
2. Switch the Best Selling Trucks carousel to the "சமீபத்தியவை" tab
3. Click a card's Download Brochure button to open its lead form
4. Fill name, mobile and city
5. Submit and verify Thank You confirmation
